# Quality Checks Reference

34 PostToolUse checks that run after file edits.
Subprocess-based checks run external tools (tsc, biome, etc.); inline checks scan file content directly.

| Check | Severity | File Types | Description |
|-------|----------|------------|-------------|
| `lint_import` (subprocess) | warning |  | Imported project lint rules with existing-debt comparison; enabled by lint import --write |
| `typescript` (subprocess) | error | .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts | TypeScript type checking after file edits |
| `biome_lint` (subprocess) | warning | .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .js ... | Biome lint check after file edits |
| `eslint` (subprocess) | warning | .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .js ... | ESLint check (used when project has eslint, not biome) |
| `secrets_in_source` (inline) | error | .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts, .js ... | Detect secrets written into source files |
| `strong_typing` (inline) | warning | .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts | Detect explicit `any` and `unknown` types — encourage stronger typing (interfaces, generics, branded types) |
| `software_version_regression` (inline) | error | package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod, Cargo.toml, Dockerfile ... | PostToolUse attention block for possible stale-memory software downgrades: package versions, model IDs, Docker tags, GitHub Action versions, API dates, and common runtime/config version assignments |
| `freshness_sensitive_reference` (inline) | warning | package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod, Cargo.toml, Dockerfile ... | PostToolUse advisory when newly introduced software/model/API references require verification against official current sources |
| `strict_typing_block` (inline) | error | .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts | PreToolUse hard-block when an edit introduces new type-erasure patterns: `as any`, `as unknown as` chains, unjustified `@ts-ignore`/`@ts-expect-error`, bare `: any` annotations. Off by default — opt in via `.interlinked/guard-rules.local.json` once the team is ready to enforce. |
| `inline_language_checks` (inline) | warning | .py, .pyi, .rs, .go, .c ... | Per-language inline pattern checks (bare except, .unwrap(), unsafe blocks, force casts, ignored err, etc.) driven by LanguageProfile.inline_checks |
| `affected_tests` (inline) | error | .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx | Run the test file corresponding to the edited source file (foo.ts → foo.test.ts) |
| `python_typecheck` (subprocess) | warning | .py | Python type checking with mypy |
| `ruff_lint` (subprocess) | warning | .py | Python linting with ruff |
| `ruff_format` (subprocess) | warning | .py | Python formatting check with ruff |
| `cargo_check` (subprocess) | error | .rs | Rust compilation check |
| `cargo_clippy` (subprocess) | warning | .rs | Rust linting with clippy |
| `rustfmt_check` (subprocess) | warning | .rs | Rust formatting check (rustfmt --check) |
| `go_build` (subprocess) | error | .go | Go compilation check |
| `golangci_lint` (subprocess) | warning | .go | Go linting with golangci-lint |
| `c_compile` (subprocess) | error | .c, .cpp, .cc, .cxx, .h ... | C/C++ compilation check |
| `clang_tidy` (subprocess) | warning | .c, .cpp, .cc, .cxx | C/C++ linting with clang-tidy |
| `semgrep` (subprocess) | warning | .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .py ... | SAST analysis with Semgrep — detects security vulnerabilities, injection flaws, and code quality issues |
| `dependency_audit` (inline) | warning | package.json, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, requirements.txt ... | SCA dependency audit — scans for known CVEs in project dependencies when lock/manifest files change |
| `gitleaks` (subprocess) | error | .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .py ... | Secrets scanning with gitleaks — detects leaked credentials, API keys, and tokens (800+ patterns) |
| `prompt_injection` (inline) | warning | .md, .txt, .json, .yaml, .yml ... | Detect prompt injection patterns in file content (indirect injection via documents) |
| `shellcheck` (subprocess) | warning | .sh, .bash, .zsh, .ksh | Shell script analysis — quoting bugs, undefined variables, POSIX compliance |
| `actionlint` (subprocess) | warning | .yml, .yaml | GitHub Actions workflow validation — syntax, expressions, action versions |
| `hadolint` (subprocess) | warning | Dockerfile, .dockerfile | Dockerfile linting — best practices, missing USER, unpinned base images |
| `taplo` (subprocess) | error | .toml | TOML validation — syntax errors in Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, etc. |
| `css_syntax` (inline) | warning | .css, .scss, .less | CSS syntax validation — brace matching, unclosed strings |
| `sql_syntax` (inline) | warning | .sql | SQL syntax validation — unbalanced parens, SELECT *, DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE |
| `package_json_consistency` (inline) | warning | package.json | package.json consistency — duplicate deps, invalid semver |
| `lockfile_drift` (inline) | warning | package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml | Lockfile drift — manifest changed but lockfile not regenerated |
| `schema_drift` (inline) | warning | .sql | Schema drift — SQL migration references columns not in schema definition |
